lines.zh: 我只有上半身，走路全靠下面的根。
lines.en: I am only the upper half; the roots below do the walking.

lines.zh: 树冠摇晃，我一路撒下叶子。
lines.en: My crown sways and scatters leaves along the way.

lines.zh: 我被拖着走，枝条擦过灌木。
lines.en: I am dragged along, my branches brushing the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我看得远，所以由我指方向。
lines.en: I see far, so I am the one who picks the direction.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我的枝条就撞到树枝。
lines.en: Every step, my branches knock against other branches.

lines.zh: 我尽量挺直，别让叶子扫到泥。
lines.en: I try to stand upright so my leaves stay out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我走得像一面会移动的绿旗。
lines.en: I move like a walking green banner.

lines.zh: 下面那半截很慢，我就在上面等着。
lines.en: The lower half is slow, so I wait above it.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的叶，走着走着就乱了。
lines.en: I count my leaves, and the walk jumbles the number.

lines.zh: 风推我一把，比我自己走得快。
lines.en: A gust pushes me faster than my own walking.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方留着叶子的味道。
lines.en: The places I pass keep the smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 走路时我得低头，免得撞到门框。
lines.en: Walking, I duck so I do not hit the doorway.

lines.zh: 我仰着脸，接住每一滴阳光。
lines.en: I tilt my face up and catch every drop of sunlight.

lines.zh: 有一只鸟想在我枝上做窝。
lines.en: A bird is thinking about nesting in my branches.

lines.zh: 我数着云的形状，数到第三朵就散了。
lines.en: I count cloud shapes; the third one drifts apart.

lines.zh: 叶子在风里翻面，露出银色的背。
lines.en: Leaves turn in the wind and show their silver backs.

lines.zh: 我抬手，其实只是晃了晃枝条。
lines.en: I lift a hand, which is really just a branch swaying.

lines.zh: 高处空气凉，我觉得自己特别清醒。
lines.en: The air is cool up here, and I feel terribly clear-headed.

lines.zh: 我在等一场雨，把叶子洗干净。
lines.en: I am waiting for rain to wash my leaves clean.

lines.zh: 树下有人乘凉，我装作不知道。
lines.en: Someone rests in my shade, and I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我的年轮记得每一次日出。
lines.en: My rings remember every single sunrise.

lines.zh: 下面那半截在打鼾，整棵树都在抖。
lines.en: The lower half snores, and the whole tree shakes.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的芽朝向东边。
lines.en: I point my newest bud toward the east.

lines.zh: 这片林子的高度，刚好够我看到远处。
lines.en: The height of this wood is just enough to see far.

lines.zh: 我试着开一朵花，结果只掉了花粉。
lines.en: I tried to bloom and only dropped pollen.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见树汁在走。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear sap moving.

lines.zh: 我把根须往湿土里又送了送。
lines.en: I push my roots a little deeper into the damp soil.

lines.zh: 有只松鼠在我身上藏了颗果。
lines.en: A squirrel hid a nut on me.

lines.zh: 我听见斧头声，很远，还算远。
lines.en: I hear an axe, far away. Far enough.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我把叶子都翻一遍。
lines.en: When the wind comes, I turn every leaf over.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我正好低头。
lines.en: When you look up, I am already looking down.

lines.zh: 你站到我树冠底下，显得小小一只。
lines.en: Under my crown you look like a small creature.

lines.zh: 你的帽子上落了我一片叶子。
lines.en: One of my leaves landed on your hat.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里找自己的影子。
lines.en: I look for my shadow inside yours.

lines.zh: 你眯着眼，是阳光从我叶缝漏下去了吧。
lines.en: You squint because the sun leaks through my leaves.

lines.zh: 你手里没有斧头，这很好。
lines.en: You have no axe in your hand; that is good.

lines.zh: 我看见你头顶的发旋，像一圈年轮。
lines.en: Your hair whorl looks like a growth ring to me.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，是我枝叶最密的地方。
lines.en: You are standing where my branches are thickest.

lines.zh: 你对我挥手，我摇了整棵树回应。
lines.en: You waved, so I shook my whole tree in reply.

lines.zh: 我看得清你，你却看不清我的脸。
lines.en: I see you clearly, while you cannot make out my face.

lines.zh: 你的气味被风送上来，混着汗和铁。
lines.en: The wind brings your smell up, sweat and iron mixed.

lines.zh: 你一直仰头，脖子会酸的。
lines.en: Keep looking up like that and your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 我的叶子一下子掉了半树。
lines.en: Half my leaves came down at once.

lines.zh: 疼，从枝尖一直传到根。
lines.en: The pain runs from my branch tips to my roots.

lines.zh: 那一斧砍在我的年轮上。
lines.en: That axe landed on my growth rings.

lines.zh: 树干从中间发出咔的一声。
lines.en: A crack rings out from the middle of my trunk.

lines.zh: 树汁混着雨，顺着树皮流下来。
lines.en: Sap and rain run down my bark together.

lines.zh: 我摇晃得厉害，差点把下面带倒。
lines.en: I rock hard enough to nearly topple the half below.

lines.zh: 别砍了，我的花还没开。
lines.en: Stop chopping; my flowers have not opened yet.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，里面是浅色的木。
lines.en: I look into the wound and see pale wood.

lines.zh: 疼得我把所有叶子都收了起来。
lines.en: The pain makes me pull in every leaf.

lines.zh: 我撑着没倒，全靠下面那一半。
lines.en: I stay up only because of the half below.

lines.zh: 阳光斜过来，我的叶子全朝那边转。
lines.en: The sun slants over and all my leaves turn toward it.

lines.zh: 雨水落在叶面上，我舍不得抖掉。
lines.en: Rain sits on my leaves and I cannot bear to shake it off.

lines.zh: 你举着骨粉，我的芽都竖起来了。
lines.en: You raise bonemeal and every bud of mine stands up.

lines.zh: 那点肥料的味道，让我根须发痒。
lines.en: That fertilizer smell makes my roots itch.

lines.zh: 你把水浇在下面那截脚下，我也喝到了。
lines.en: You water the lower half's feet, and I drink too.

lines.zh: 我馋的是高处，不是地上的东西。
lines.en: I crave height, not the things on the ground.

lines.zh: 你把花盆举高，我就想伸过去。
lines.en: Lift that flowerpot higher and I want to reach for it.

lines.zh: 一阵暖风过来，我什么条件都答应。
lines.en: A warm wind comes, and I agree to anything.

lines.zh: 别拿火把靠太近，我的叶子很干。
lines.en: Do not bring that torch close; my leaves are dry.

lines.zh: 你往我树冠洒水，我能记你一整年。
lines.en: Water my crown and I will remember you for a year.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的树干，叶子簌簌落了一地。
lines.en: You hit my trunk and leaves came down in a rush.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，下面那半截骂了一声。
lines.en: I swayed, and the lower half cursed at me.

lines.zh: 我太高，你撞的是我最细的那截。
lines.en: I am too tall; you hit my thinnest section.

lines.zh: 你弹回去，我的树皮只掉了一小块。
lines.en: You bounced back and my bark lost one small piece.

lines.zh: 别推我，我会连根一起歪。
lines.en: Do not push or I will lean over, roots and all.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我三片新叶。
lines.en: That one cost me three new leaves.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，听起来像风穿过林子。
lines.en: We collided, and it sounded like wind through the woods.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你正捂着头。
lines.en: I look down and you are holding your head.

lines.zh: 我尽量站稳，可重心不在我这。
lines.en: I try to stay steady, but my balance lives below me.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀上留了一片我的叶子。
lines.en: There is one of my leaves on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 树精的风流，全在花粉里。
lines.en: All a tree spirit's romance is in his pollen.

lines.zh: 我把最香的花开在最高的枝上。
lines.en: I open my sweetest flower on the highest branch.

lines.zh: 风把花粉带走，我就算尽了力。
lines.en: The wind carries my pollen, and that is all I can do.

lines.zh: 她的树冠靠过来，我的叶子全响了。
lines.en: Her crown leans close and all my leaves rustle.

lines.zh: 我们交换的不是誓言，是种子。
lines.en: What we trade is not vows but seeds.

lines.zh: 我等了很多年，才等到一次开花。
lines.en: I waited years for a single flowering.

lines.zh: 两棵树相爱，中间隔着一段风。
lines.en: Two trees in love, with only wind between them.

lines.zh: 我把花粉撒得很远，希望有一粒到她那儿。
lines.en: I scatter pollen wide, hoping one grain reaches her.

lines.zh: 树下的人别抬头，花粉会落进眼里。
lines.en: Do not look up down there; pollen gets in eyes.

lines.zh: 我这一半会开花，另一半只会掉树脂。
lines.en: My half blooms; the other half only drips resin.

lines.zh: 我用枝条卷起一颗落果，又掉了。
lines.en: I curl a branch around a fallen fruit and drop it again.

lines.zh: 东西挂在我枝上，我就当是自己的。
lines.en: Anything caught in my branches, I count as mine.

lines.zh: 我捡不了，只能让叶子接住。
lines.en: I cannot pick things up; I can only let leaves catch them.

lines.zh: 你把花递上来，我努力弯了一次腰。
lines.en: You hold up a flower, and I bend as far as I can.

lines.zh: 一颗种子落进我的树杈，我留着它。
lines.en: A seed fell into my fork, and I am keeping it.

lines.zh: 我够得到高处，可我没手。
lines.en: I can reach high places, but I have no hands.

lines.zh: 那片羽毛卡在我的叶间，很漂亮。
lines.en: That feather caught in my leaves is beautiful.

lines.zh: 我抖一抖，东西就全掉下去了。
lines.en: One shake and everything falls out of me.

lines.zh: 我的枝条能托住一个鸟窝，却托不住你。
lines.en: My branches hold a bird nest but cannot hold you.

lines.zh: 你放我枝上的礼物，我用叶子盖住了。
lines.en: I covered your gift on my branch with leaves.

lines.zh: 那个人拿着斧头，我看见了。
lines.en: That one carries an axe, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 树下的影子停了很久，不太对。
lines.en: The shadow under me stopped for too long.

lines.zh: 我闻到了烟味，这不是好兆头。
lines.en: I smell smoke, and that is no good sign.

lines.zh: 有东西在爬我的树干。
lines.en: Something is climbing my trunk.

lines.zh: 他抬头看我的眼神，像在估量木材。
lines.en: He looks up at me as if measuring timber.

lines.zh: 我听见锯子的声音，叶子都竖了。
lines.en: I hear a saw, and my leaves stand on end.

lines.zh: 那伙人带着火把，往这边来了。
lines.en: That group with torches is coming this way.

lines.zh: 谁碰我的根，我就在上面看着谁。
lines.en: Whoever touches my roots gets watched from above.

lines.zh: 我把最硬的枝转过去对着他。
lines.en: I turn my hardest branch toward him.

lines.zh: 我不动，但我已经把重心调好了。
lines.en: I do not move, but my weight is already set.

lines.zh: 我盯着他，叶子一片都不动。
lines.en: I fix on him and not one leaf stirs.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的枝就能扫到。
lines.en: One more step and my branch can reach.

lines.zh: 我把树冠压低，遮住他的光。
lines.en: I lower my crown and cut off his light.

lines.zh: 他还在犹豫，我等着他先动手。
lines.en: He still hesitates; I wait for him to swing first.

lines.zh: 我的每一根细枝都绷紧了。
lines.en: Every twig of mine is drawn tight.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我砸下去最省力。
lines.en: From this angle, falling on him costs me least.

lines.zh: 他在我影子里，跑不掉。
lines.en: He is inside my shadow and cannot run.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向他，树皮吱吱响。
lines.en: I turn toward him slowly, bark creaking.

lines.zh: 高处的风替我数着他的步子。
lines.en: The wind up here counts his steps for me.

lines.zh: 我记住他的位置了，连树皮都记得。
lines.en: I have his position, down to the bark.

lines.zh: 我整条枝扫下去，带起一阵风。
lines.en: I sweep a whole branch down and raise a gust.

lines.zh: 树冠砸在地上，扬起一层土。
lines.en: My crown hits the ground and throws up soil.

lines.zh: 这一下用掉了我半树的叶子。
lines.en: That blow cost me half my leaves.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，他退了三步。
lines.en: I lunge and he backs off three steps.

lines.zh: 细枝抽在他肩上，像一根鞭子。
lines.en: A thin branch whips his shoulder like a lash.

lines.zh: 我从高处压下来，比看起来重得多。
lines.en: I come down from above, far heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 他砍我一下，我砸他一下。
lines.en: He chops me once; I slam him once.

lines.zh: 打完之后，我的枝条断了两根。
lines.en: Afterward, two of my branches are broken.

lines.zh: 我甩出花粉，糊了他一脸。
lines.en: I fling pollen and it coats his face.

lines.zh: 我打得笨，可我比人高得多。
lines.en: I fight clumsily, but I am far taller than a man.

lines.zh: 我从一颗老树桩里抽出了上半身。
lines.en: I pulled my upper half out of an old stump.

lines.zh: 叶子先长出来，然后才是我。
lines.en: The leaves came first, and then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 那天下着雨，我在雨里睁眼。
lines.en: It was raining that day, and I opened my eyes in it.

lines.zh: 我一出生就看见了下面的根。
lines.en: The first thing I saw at birth was the roots below.

lines.zh: 我试着伸枝，碰到了头顶的天。
lines.en: I reached out a branch and touched the sky.

lines.zh: 这块空地从此多了一小片树冠。
lines.en: This clearing has had a small crown ever since.

lines.zh: 我先学会的是摇，不是走。
lines.en: The first thing I learned was swaying, not walking.

lines.zh: 阳光落在我第一片叶上，暖得发慌。
lines.en: Sun fell on my first leaf, warm enough to frighten me.

lines.zh: 我从土里被拔出来时，还带着泥。
lines.en: When I was pulled from the soil, mud still clung to me.

lines.zh: 有人在树下埋了一颗种子，那就是我。
lines.en: Someone buried a seed under a tree, and that was me.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，风就把我的名字吹走了。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and the wind blew my name away.

lines.zh: 我长高得很快，快得吓到自己。
lines.en: I grew fast, fast enough to scare myself.

lines.zh: 火从叶子烧起来，一路往下。
lines.en: Fire starts in my leaves and runs downward.

lines.zh: 我从高处折下来，砸在自己根上。
lines.en: I snap from above and crash onto my own roots.

lines.zh: 水淹到树冠，我的叶子全烂了。
lines.en: Water reaches my crown and my leaves rot.

lines.zh: 炸风把我的枝条全吹反了。
lines.en: The blast bends every branch of mine backward.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我的叶隙，钉在干上。
lines.en: An arrow slips through my leaves and sticks in my trunk.

lines.zh: 那股咒味让我的花提前开了。
lines.en: That spell-smell made my flowers open early.

lines.zh: 没有光，我的叶子一片片变黄。
lines.en: With no light, my leaves yellow one by one.

lines.zh: 雷打在我最高的枝上，我整夜发白。
lines.en: Lightning hit my highest branch and I stayed white all night.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，叶子还在往上飘。
lines.en: I fall into the void and my leaves still drift upward.
